items.title: Valsin and Rooks to Join Kittley’s Weekly ESPN+ Presser
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley will be joined by senior WR Kelby Valsin and graduate DB Tyson Rooks for a Tuesday, Nov. 16 press conference, airing live on ESPN+ at 12 p.m.

items.title: Kickoff Time at ECU Scheduled for 1 P.M.
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's 2026 regular season finale against East Carolina on Saturday, Nov. 28 is set for 1 p.m. on ESPN+, announced by the American Conference on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Messer Named Biletnikoff Award Semifinalist
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Easton Messer, Florida Atlantic football's dynamic fifth-year wide receiver, is one of 13 semifinalists for the Biletnikoff Award, as announced by the Tallahassee Quarterback Club (TQC) Foundation, Inc. on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Florida Atlantic Stalls in Tulsa
items.summary: TULSA, Okla. – Florida Atlantic football fell to Tulsa on the road, 38-21, on Saturday evening.

items.title: Football Game Time at Tulsa Moves to 7:15 PM ET
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – The American Conference announced on Friday that Florida Atlantic's football game at Tulsa has been changed to 7:15 p.m. ET Saturday.

items.title: Countdown to Kickoff: Game 10 at Tulsa
items.summary: TULSA, Okla. — Florida Atlantic football is on the road for a meeting with Tulsa on Saturday, Nov. 14. Kickoff on Skelly Field at H.A. Chapman Stadium is set for 7:15 p.m. ET, airing on ESPN+.

items.title: Where Are They Now: Johnnie Sloan
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Johnnie Sloan, a member of the inaugural Florida Atlantic football team, carries the lessons he learned from Howard Schnellenberger with him to this day as the head coach at Coconut Creek High School.

items.title: Pads Off with Dominique Henry
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Dominique Henry is featured in this week's "Pads Off", a segment hosted by Frank Forte where they talk anything but football.

items.title: Who’s Hot in Week 10
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic graduate QB Caden Veltkamp has been listed on week 10's Who's Hot on the Maxwell Award Watch List.
